CHIEF COMPLAINT & ENCOUNTER DETAILS
Encounter: Initial oncology consultation for palpable right breast mass. Patient reports a self-discovered, non-tender nodule in the upper
outer quadrant of the right breast.
CLINICAL PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Right Breast: Discrete, firm, mobile mass palpable at approximately the 10 o'clock position, measuring approximately 2.0 to 2.5 cm on
manual palpation. No overlying skin retraction or peau d'orange. No spontaneous nipple discharge.
Left Breast: Symmetrical, soft, no dominant masses, nodules, or architectural distortion.
Regional Lymph Nodes: No palpable lymphadenopathy in bilateral axillae, supraclavicular, or infraclavicular fossae.
